intent: Implement R2dbcTelemetryHistoryRepository (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux/Reactor/R2DBC, constructor injection, no blocking calls) so that the frozen test passes, providing exactly the ast_hints table and nothing improvised. Unit contract: Infrastructure adapter implementing TelemetryHistoryRepository with DatabaseClient against tables telemetry_sample (id, device_id, metric = enum name, t_device, t_ingress, value, validation_status, unique (device_id, metric, t_device)) and event_revision (id, sample_id, reason, value, t_ingress, revision_no, unique (sample_id, revision_no)). Instants are stored as UTC LocalDateTime. appendSample returns the generated id and maps a unique-identity violation to an EMPTY Mono (dedup of at-least-once retries) while every other error propagates; appendRevision computes max(revision_no)+1 (first = 1); findWindow orders by t_device ascending with LIMIT. INSERT only: no UPDATE or DELETE exists. Registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration.

methods.signature: Mono<Integer> appendRevision(long sampleId, RevisionReason reason, double value, Instant tIngress)
Flux<TelemetrySample> findWindow(String deviceId, MetricKind metric, Instant from, Instant to, int limit)
